title: SAMPLE: Comparing career interests
source_organization: PathBridge AI capstone demonstration — not an official source
content: SAMPLE ONLY: Original demonstration guidance, not verified occupational research. For career exploration, write down activities you enjoy and tasks you would like to try. Compare two possible career topics by asking what interests you about each and what you still need to learn. Discuss your questions and practical constraints with a school counselor. Before committing to a program, check its current official information with a counselor. This document supplies no salary statistics, admission requirements, tuition figures, scholarship eligibility, or guaranteed outcomes.
